Site terms.

These terms describe the basic use of the All Bizzness Sports website, podcast information, local-sports coverage, and scoreboard features.

Last updated: October 1, 2026

1. Website information

All Bizzness Sports publishes local sports conversation, podcast information, community links, and selected big-league scoreboard information for general interest. Content may change, be delayed, or contain errors. A live score, schedule, or podcast page should not be treated as a guarantee of an outcome or as professional, financial, or wagering advice.

2. External services and links

The site links to third-party services including Facebook, YouTube, external sports-data services, and Davidson Digital Design. The Episodes section also uses YouTube’s privacy-enhanced embedded player. Those services control their own availability, content, fees, privacy practices, cookies, and terms. A link or embedded player does not mean All Bizzness Sports operates or endorses the linked service.

3. Acceptable use

Please do not use the site to interfere with its operation, probe or bypass security controls without permission, submit unlawful material, scrape protected data, distribute malicious code, or misrepresent your identity or affiliation.

4. Content and marks

All Bizzness Sports branding, original page copy, and original site design are presented for the site’s own use. Team names, league names, logos, video, and linked platform content belong to their respective owners. Do not copy or republish material beyond what applicable law permits without permission from the relevant rights holder.

5. Availability and disclaimers

The website is provided on an “as available” basis. Features may be changed, paused, or removed, and third-party data may be unavailable. To the extent permitted by applicable law, All Bizzness Sports disclaims warranties that the site will be uninterrupted, error-free, or complete.

Nothing in these terms removes a right or protection that cannot lawfully be excluded where you live.

6. Privacy and cookie choices

Use of the site is also described in the Privacy Policy. Cloudflare Web Analytics provides privacy-focused technical measurement, while optional Google Analytics only loads after consent. You can review the browser preference control at any time with .

7. Changes and questions

These terms may be updated when the site or its features change. The current version is the one published on this page. The current public contact route for questions is the official Facebook page; no separate legal email has been supplied for this build.
